envelope.description: Settle requests and refuse at the entry

body.title: Settle requests and refuse at the entry
body.summary: Add settleSignoff (read each open request of the unit's listed stages once, record signed-off or signoff-changes on every artifact of a request together, release the claim, run the deferred completion) and settleForAttempt (settle the followed stage's unit, then refuse when blockedBySignoff still blocks, independently of the gate's first-author exception).
acceptanceChecks: settleSignoff records signed-off on all artifacts of a completed request together, then clears the assignee and runs the held completion
A part-way failure leaves the rest, keeps the stage blocked and releases nothing
settleForAttempt refuses a first design.story turn on a story with no issue while the HLD awaits signoff
No tracker call is made outside team mode or when no listed stage has an open request

tests.name: src/workflow/team/__tests__/signoff.test.ts: settleSignoff records signed-off on all artifacts of a completed request, clears the assignee of the unit issue, records signoff-changes on changes-requested, leaves the rest on a part-way failure, skips a Signoff whose Reference is not a signoff-request, and is idempotent across two clones

src/workflow/team/__tests__/signoff-hook.test.ts: settleForAttempt refuses a first design.story turn on a story whose issue could not be created while the HLD awaits signoff, before teamGate's allowFirstAuthor exception is reached
src/workflow/__tests__/signoff-hold.test.ts: settleSignoff completes the Story and its Epic once signed-off is recorded, with the members cascaded
